subtitle: Lesson 14 · Oracle Security & User Management

code:
CREATE PROFILE app_password_policy LIMIT
  PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME 90
  PASSWORD_GRACE_TIME 7
  PASSWORD_REUSE_TIME 365
  PASSWORD_REUSE_MAX 10
  FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 5
  PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME 1
  PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION ora12c_strong_verify_function;

ALTER USER app_owner PROFILE app_password_policy;
caption: Password parameters are enforced by default — no switch required.

code:
ALTER SYSTEM SET RESOURCE_LIMIT = TRUE;

CREATE PROFILE reporting_limits LIMIT
  SESSIONS_PER_USER 3
  CPU_PER_CALL 3000
  CONNECT_TIME 480
  IDLE_TIME 30
  COMPOSITE_LIMIT UNLIMITED;
caption: Resource limits sit unused until RESOURCE_LIMIT = TRUE at the instance level.
